## About Me

Hello! I'm **Wei**, a researcher and developer with a passion for Deep Learning, Reinforcement Learning, and intelligent systems.

> "Attention Is All You Need"

## Research Interests

- **Deep Reinforcement Learning** — Multi-agent systems, cooperative strategies
- **Natural Language Processing** — Transformer architectures, LLMs
- **Multi-Agent Systems** — Role assignment, swarm intelligence

Page.title: Projects
Page._content:
## My Projects

Here are some of the projects I've been working on.

### 🧠 Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning

Research on cooperative multi-agent systems with role-based assignment strategies.

- Role discovery and assignment in heterogeneous teams
- Swarm adversarial task planning
- Policy optimization for multi-agent coordination

### 🔬 Deep Learning Research

Exploring cutting-edge architectures and training methodologies.

- Transformer-based models
- Contrastive learning approaches
- Efficient neural network design

---

*More projects coming soon. Check out my [GitHub](https://github.com/xwqianbei) for the latest work.*
